turns.text: Or should I say, she once had me?
turns.zh: 还是该说，她曾经拥有过我？

turns.text: She asked me to stay, and she told me to sit anywhere
turns.zh: 她让我留下来，还让我随便坐

turns.text: So I looked around, and I noticed there wasn't a chair
turns.zh: 于是我环顾四周，发现连把椅子都没有

turns.text: Biding my time, drinking her wine
turns.zh: 一边等着，一边喝着她的酒

turns.text: And then she said, "It's time for bed"
She told me she worked in the morning and started to laugh
turns.zh: 她说她早上要上班，然后笑了起来

turns.text: I told her, "I didn't," and crawled off to sleep in the bath
turns.zh: 我跟她说「我不用」，就爬去浴缸里睡了

turns.text: I was alone, this bird had flown
turns.zh: 我孤身一人，这鸟儿已经飞走了
